scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:chrome && npm run bundle:edge && npm run bundle:firefox && npm run bundle:firefox-android
scripts.bundle:chrome: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip --browser chrome --mv3
scripts.bundle:edge: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip --browser edge --mv3
scripts.bundle:firefox: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip --browser firefox --mv2
scripts.bundle:firefox-android: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip --browser firefox-android --mv2
scripts.check-types: npm run generate:locales && wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run generate:locales && wxt prepare && eslint src --max-warnings 0
